messages:
eva-partnerships: Heads up — APAC hardware reseller is blocking the marketplace PO because their EDI ACKs aren’t matching our PO IDs. They sent back null/000 values for the PO number on a bunch of POs. Can infra/legal/sales chime in?

sam-sales: ugh. which reseller?

eva-partnerships: hiro@hana-tech. region APAC (SG). They raised support ticket 8742 and pasted this in the portal.

hiro-vendor: hi, we're seeing the issue on our side after the schema change last week. some upstream mapping defaulted to 000 when invoice.partner_po_id is absent. working on a fix but need the original PO payloads to verify.

vendor-infra-bot: Automated note: Marketplace connector log snippet attached. Request IDs: rq_9c3, rq_9c4.

sam-sales: can you paste one of the offending EDI fragments here (sanitized)?

hiro-vendor: sure — sending a sample:
```
ISA*00*          *00*          *ZZ*HANA           *ZZ*REDWOOD        *200323*1700*U*00401*000000123*0*T*:~
GS*PO*HANA*REDWOOD*20200323*1700*123*X*004010~
ST*850*0001~
BEG*00*SA*0000000000**20200323~
REF*IA*8742~
PO1*1*10*EA*100**VN*HW-1234~
CTT*1~
SE*8*0001~
GE*1*123~
IEA*1*000000123~
```

luca-legal: BEG segment with BEG*00*SA*0000000000 is definitely our problem — our PO number field went empty after the export mask. This is the field legal uses for PO acceptance tracking. We need to ensure our connector populates PO number before EDI generation.

tanya-ops: Ops saw a change in the marketplace export pipeline on 200120 — likely the PR that updated the po serialization to handle fallback IDs. rolling back is an option but would break another partner.

sam-sales: timeline? Sales needs confirmed POs for Hana to accept billing. They won't move forward without valid po numbers.

eva-partnerships: short-term plan: 1) hiro, patch vendor mapping to treat inbound po_ref from our HTTP API as authoritative (avoid default 000). 2) tanya, add a filter to our export to inject legacy_po when present. 3) luca, confirm if legal can accept an interim addendum that allows resend of corrected EDI acks without re-signing the whole SOW.

hiro-vendor: I can push a hotfix today to stop zero-padding the PO number and to accept partner_po_id header. will need sample payloads to test.

vendor-infra-bot: staging test results: inbound with header X-Partner-PO: RWI-2020-223 yields BEG*00*SA*RWI-2020-223 in our EDI after patch.

tanya-ops: I'll schedule a rolling deploy to marketplace-export at 23:00 UTC, with a quick rollback window. tagging infra oncall.

luca-legal: we can sign a narrow addendum for this fix (resend of corrected EDI POs only). will draft and circulate by EOD.

eva-partnerships: thanks — next steps: hiro pushes patch + test, tanya deploys at 23:00, luca drafts addendum. sam, please brief Hana contact that we have a mitigation timeline. I'll update the ticket and set a transient SLA.

sam-sales: will do. looping in hana-tech procurement: @hiro (hana) — we expect resend within 24h after deploy. :thumbsup:

eva-partnerships: marking this as high priority. ping here when deploy is complete.

vendor-infra-bot: Deploy started: marketplace-export v2.14.3 -> prod at 23:03 UTC.

eva-partnerships: deployed and verified — BEG segment now populated in samples.

hiro-vendor: confirmed acceptance on Hana portal for the corrected ACKs. ticket 8742 marked resolved by vendor.

luca-legal: addendum signed via DocuSign, covers reissuance of corrected POs and does not change commercial terms.

sam-sales: Hana confirmed invoices accepted and billing will proceed. closing loop with Hana procurement.

eva-partnerships: great — closing thread. please reopen if any downstream billing reconciliation flags pop up. :party-parrot:
